input.quote: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient,
input.rationale: The Section 2 grant is unqualifiedly "revocable" — i.e. terminable at Kubient's discretion at any time during the Term — and names only "Customer", with no coverage for AP Affiliates or contractors acting on AP's behalf. Section 6(a) (p0025) makes matters worse by barring any third-party access absent Kubient's advance written approval, so there is no notice-based path to add Affiliates; this combination sits in walk-away territory rather than at the fallback. The successor/M&A element of the fallback is separately satisfied by the assignment clause at p0072 (assignment permitted without consent to an affiliate or a purchaser of substantially all assets or successor by merger), so no change is needed there. Redline extends the grant to Affiliates and contractors and limits revocation to expiration or termination under Section 4, consistent with the existing termination mechanics at p0021.

proposal.summary: Extend the Auction Platform licence to AP Affiliates and contractors acting on AP's behalf and remove at-will revocability.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Auction Platform licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and tied revocation to expiration or termination under Section 4 rather than leaving the grant revocable at Kubient's discretion. Our playbook does not permit a licence that can be pulled at will or that excludes the affiliates and service providers who actually operate our ad stack; if helpful, we can instead cover Affiliates on written notice to Kubient.

ops.newText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable (except as permitted under this Agreement), without right of sublicense, license, revocable only upon expiration or termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 4, to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient,
